_what: The house pigeon's channel-change flights, generated in Higgsfield on 2026-10-05 at the owner's instruction. Since late 2026-10-05 every flight is a COVER flight (owner: 'the pigeons have lost the transition effect for example a wing covering the full screen'; 'varying lengths of animations to be used according to the tuning time of a channel'): start and end frame are the same 4K image of the pigeon's wing filling the frame (cover_media), so flights chain wing to wing and the channel cuts behind the wing. Seedance 2.5 omni_reference 1080p high bitrate, house reference Pigeon-Reference-4K.jpg. Masters and the cover image are owner-local under output/Higgsfield Assets/Khajistan Flights 2026-10-05/ (Sources/cover-*.mp4, Cover/wing-cover-4k.png).

refused.kling3_0 4k twirl fd6cc694, swoop 5ae403: smoke-like smears behind the wings, a bird frozen in place for 1.5 s, and a body twisted into an S (spiral). Kling 3.0 renders straight flight well and acrobatics badly.
refused.kling3_0 4k across af0ec211, approach 65: wings held still through most of the shot; the kept takes beat.
refused.kling3_0 4k roller 62dc5723-1e07-4795-86: frozen for its first four frames, then the 'roll' is a smear of the wings on a bird that keeps its side-on pose.
refused.kling3_0 4k display be25ae06-e810-450f-8: ghosted, doubled wings in its third and fourth seconds.
refused.seedance_2_5 roller 536c8539-3d87-4be9-a: a sound roll but the second take (kept) tumbles in place, as a roller does; this one is not refused for a defect and is the spare.
refused.kling3_0 4k approach 17459310-82fa-4034-: asked for a sharp close pass over the lens; both hover and fly up and away, never coming nearer than 10% of the frame.
refused.kling3_0 4k across b0ec2b84, approach c9: out of focus whenever the bird is near the lens: bird sharpness fell from ~250 to ~5 over the last 1.5 s of each. Owner: 'the feathers get pixelated and blurry'. Remade in Seedance, which keeps feather barbs at its closest.
refused.seedance_2_5 across 44d10e93-ca0c-4297-9: never comes nearer than 11% of the frame: not the 'into us' flight.
refused.seedance_2_5 approach 49abda56-b528-4569: fills two-thirds of the frame and lingers there.

credits: 1666.75 in all, measured off the Higgsfield balance: 1821.5 at the start; 643.25 before the cover flights; 154.75 after them (2026-10-05/06: two cover images, seven cover flights = 488.5).
pipeline: render_flight.py: per-pixel backdrop plate (whichever of end-frames median and flight median is closer to neutral grey), alpha = (C-B).(F-B)/|F-B|^2 with F spread from the solid bird, colourless shadows dropped, colour premultiplied, Seedance plumage Lab-matched to the Kling bird (colour.json, gain capped 1.5); the generator's slow opening retimed to half the clip's median pace (at most 3x) and a close pass over the lens (bird over 60% of the frame, out of focus) at 3x; tail cut where the bird stops moving, a still-on-edge ending faded over 6 frames. Laid on each skin's ground and encoded opaque: H.264 1080 for every flight, HEVC 2160 from a 4K source. HEVC with alpha was dropped 2026-10-05: the Apple TV HD decodes it in software and lost frames while a channel tuned. Cover flights (render_flight.py <src> <out> <name> <cover.png> [speed]): a backdrop plate per frame (Seedance relights its grey as the bird pulls back), no colour table, still wing trimmed, first and last three frames blended onto the exact cover image; darts played at 1.8x.
